messages:
mia-nguyen: Quick follow-up from the billing postmortem — we found the delayed token ingest was from the dedupe window flip in the backfill runner. Posting action items and owners so nothing slips.

omar-patel: Ack. Can you paste the short root cause note?

mia-nguyen: Root cause TL;DR: backfill job changed dedupe-window default from 24h -> 0h in a deploy on 2026-03-18; that caused duplicate suppression to fail and the ingestion pipeline to stall while retrying. Result: ~18M tokens delayed across 3 ingestion batches.

adele-choi: I can own the billing-side correction (invoice credits + customer outreach). Assigning to @adele-choi. ETA EOD Fri (2026-03-27) for initial credit calculations.

raj-kumar: I'll own the backfill runner fix + canary rollback plan. Plan: revert dedupe-window default, add explicit env var validation, add a deploy gate. ETA tomorrow morning (2026-03-24).

chloe-bennett: I'll take the alerting/observability work: add metric for failed dedupe count and a Grafana panel for 'ingest-delay-age' + a PagerDuty rule when >1h backlog. Target EOW (2026-03-27).

billing-bot: Automated note: affected invoice window IDs: IW-20260318-{42,43,44}. Estimated impacted customer count: 128.

omar-patel: Action item formatting for handoff: 1) fix/revert PR (owner: raj) 2) deploy canary + verify latency (owner: raj & chloe) 3) run deterministic reingest (owner: raj) 4) compute credit amounts (owner: adele) 5) notify customers (owner: adele) 6) add postmortem follow-up checks (owner: chloe).

mia-nguyen: Adding gating + acceptance criteria: the revert must reduce backlog to <1% of previous within 30m of canary; observability panels should show backlog drop; reingest must be idempotent and include a digest log for customers.

raj-kumar: quick log excerpt from the failing run: 
```
2026-03-18T21:14:02Z ERROR backfill.runner dedupe: window=0m duplicate_check_timeout
2026-03-18T21:14:02Z WARN backfill.runner retrying item=abcd1234 attempts=5
```
Will attach full logs to the PR.

chloe-bennett: For the new metric here's the query I'll add to the ingest-exporter: 
```
sum by (shard) (increase(token_ingest_delayed_total[5m]))
```
I'll add an SLO check so we get an oncall ping before user-visible invoices are impacted.

adele-choi: For credits, I'll run the crediting script but need canonical token delta per account. Requesting a CSV from ingestion team with columns: account_id, original_tokens, delayed_tokens, corrected_invoice_id. Raj can you generate the CSV after reingest?

raj-kumar: Yes — after I run the idempotent reingest I'll output that CSV and drop it in s3://redwood-postmortem/3472005555/deltas.csv. ETA 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC.

mia-nguyen: Scheduling a 30m sync tomorrow 2026-03-24 10:30 UTC to verify canary and gating. Please add a short checklist to the meeting invite with links to the PR, dashboard, and the reingest playbook.

omar-patel: Noted. Also recommendation: add a deploy-time lint that prevents zero-valued durable windows. That should stop human config mistakes. I'll open a lint PR and tag infra.

chloe-bennett: I'll add the dashboard panels and a synthetic test that simulates a stuck dedupe. If the synthetic fails we auto-open a ticket in #incidents.

adele-choi: Customer comms note draft ETA 2026-03-26; will request legal review if any credits exceed $5k.

mia-nguyen: Logging the short action tracker here so we can reference in the postmortem doc: 
- raj-kumar: revert dedupe default + canary (due 2026-03-24 AM)
- raj-kumar: reingest and produce deltas.csv -> s3 (due 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC)
- adele-choi: calc credits, draft comms (due 2026-03-26)
- chloe-bennett: dashboards + alerts + synthetic test (due 2026-03-27)
- omar-patel: deploy-time lint PR (no strict ETA, please tag infra)

raj-kumar: I'll update the PR with test run screenshots and the s3 path as soon as reingest completes.

chloe-bennett: thumbs up :thumbsup: and I'll wire the PD escalation.

mia-nguyen: Thanks team. If anyone hits a blocker ping @mia-nguyen and I'll escalate. Closing thread once deltas.csv is in place and credits are queued.

billing-bot: Reminder: scheduled invoice snapshot job will run 2026-03-25T02:00Z — if reingest runs after that we may need an invoice reissue window.

adele-choi: Noted — I'll coordinate reissue windows with finance ops.
